src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = 6 if any(6 in row for row in grid) else 9
    row_cuts = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == sep for v in row)]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    r_bounds = [-1] + row_cuts + [h]
    c_bounds = [-1] + col_cuts + [w]
    rsegs = [(r_bounds[i]+1,r_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(r_bounds)-1)]
    csegs = [(c_bounds[i]+1,c_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(c_bounds)-1)]
    # The source design occupies the upper-right cell; repeat it into every panel.
    r0,r1 = rsegs[0]; c0,c1 = csegs[-1]
    pattern = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ra,rb in rsegs:
        for ca,cb in csegs:
            for r in range(ra,rb):
                for c in range(ca,cb):
                    out[r][c] = pattern[(r-ra)%len(pattern)][(c-ca)%len(pattern[0])]
    return out
'''
